desc: Derive the movement math: prefix displacement P[t]; particle born at time b is at P[t] - P[b] at time t+0.5; initial smoke is b=0.
Determine birth rule: at step t after wind, if no birth b<t has P[b]==P[t], a new particle is born at time t.
Key observation: smoke at (R,C) at t+0.5 iff some birth b≤t has P[b] = P[t] - (R,C); maintain set of P[b].
Compute birth times incrementally: check P[t] membership before adding; P[0]=(0,0) starts in set.
Answer queries after the generation step each t; build output string.
Verify algorithm on Sample 1 by hand (produces 001010, matches).
Implement final Python solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read, tuple positions in set), order: compute P[t] → generation check/add → query; output joined string.
